attr.title: FEZ
attr.desc: Gomez is a 2D creature living in a 2D world. Or is he? When the existence of a mysterious 3rd dimension is revealed to him, Gomez is sent out on a journey that will take him to the very fabric of space and time.
attr.inst: Install the port files, then copy the contents of your Linux install of FEZ (FEZ.exe, the Content folder and everything beside them) into the gamedata folder.
attr.inst_md:
- Install the port via PortMaster.
- You need to own FEZ, and this runs the **Linux** build of it. On a Linux PC, Steam has already put that under `~/.steam/steam/steamapps/common/FEZ`. On Windows or macOS, open the Steam console with `steam://open/console` and run `download_depot 224760 224762`; it reports the download folder when it finishes.
- Copy the contents into `ports/fez/gamedata`, so `FEZ.exe` and the `Content` folder sit directly in there.
- Enjoy.
